turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Sure! Imagine your parrot only eats crackers when you ring a bell. Over time, just ringing the bell might make the parrot hungry for crackers, even without showing the food. That's how a neutral stimulus (the bell) can become associated with an unconditioned stimulus (crackers) through repeated pairing, creating a conditioned response.
